status: PRE-REGISTERED before any outcome data have been inspected; analysis implementation is the next phase
supersedes: all Phase 1/2 detection claims and catalogs in this repository (falsified 2026-11-14)
commitment: Results will be written up and made public regardless of sign. A null result is the expected primary outcome and will not be reframed as a detection.

hypothesis.null: After instrumental-systematics removal and with a calibrated complexity estimator, the rate of low-complexity EVENTS in confirmed Pleiades members is statistically indistinguishable from (a) matched field controls in the same TESS sectors/cameras/CCDs and (b) phase-randomised surrogates preserving power spectrum, amplitude distribution and gaps.
hypothesis.alternative: Pleiades members show an excess of low-complexity events with a global trials-corrected p < 0.01 AND the events recur in the same stars across independent sectors AND survive pixel-level vetting.
hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 is accepted ONLY if every one of its conditions holds simultaneously. If any single condition fails, H0 stands and the result is reported as a null result / systematics characterisation. Detection language and 'quantum network' framing are prohibited in all outputs.
hypothesis.signal_model: Narrow-band non-natural intensity modulation: duty cycle 0.1-0.5, bit length 0.5-4 h, depth 0.02%-2%, repetition not an integer multiple of the stellar rotation period, persisting across >=2 independent sectors. Estimator response to this model is fixed by injection BEFORE real-data tests.

sample.data_product_fallback: TESS-SPOC FFI 200s for the ENTIRE sample (never mixed)

controls.source: field stars in the SAME sector / camera / CCD
controls.exclude: cluster parallax + proper-motion locus and the cluster cone

symbolization.scale: fixed per-star robust noise sigma (MAD of clipped detrended residuals)

statistic.event_definition: maximal run of consecutive flagged windows = 1 event

null_model.method: IAAFT phase-randomisation preserving power spectrum, amplitude distribution and gap structure
null_model.threshold: 1st percentile of the star's own surrogate complexity distribution

significance.primary_endpoint: global two-sample event-rate test, targets vs matched controls
significance.rate_model: negative binomial (overdispersion allowed); Poisson as sensitivity
significance.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across stars and windows
significance.look_elsewhere: all pre-registered parameter grids included in the trials factor

validation.baseline: matched filter / BLS on the identical data

for_every_surviving_event: same-timestamp neighbours on the same CCD
vetting.instrumental_verdict_if: event coincides with ANY CCD-wide systematic or flagged cadence

falsification_tests: event rate consistent with matched controls at 95% -> H1 rejected
events vanish under hard mask or 5-sigma clipping -> instrumental
events coincide with shared CCD systematics / scattered-light epochs -> instrumental
no recurrence of the same stars in S70/71 vs S42-44 -> not persistent
complexity estimator lacks dynamic range on simulations -> method invalid, stop

reproducibility.planned_entry_point_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED - pre-registration precedes implementation by design

authorship.ai_disclosure: AI-assisted analysis disclosed in acknowledgements; AI is not an author
